question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Referance'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling for the given word is 'Reference'.

Let's see the meaning of the given word:

 
• Reference__: L**ooking at something for information (जानकारी पाने के लिए कुछ देखने की क्रिया)**

 __
 
• ​E.g.__- The guidebook might be useful for future **reference**.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is 'Referance'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Committee__: **A group of people who have been chosen to discuss something or decide something (समिति****)**

 

__
 
• ​E.g.__- The local council has just set up a **committee** to study recycling.

 

__
 
• ​**Develop__**: T**o grow slowly, increase, or change into something else (विकसित होना; विकास करना****)**

 __
 
• ​E.g.__- Scientists have **developed** a drug against this disease.
 
 
 
• ​**__Beginning__**: T**he first part of something (किसी वस्‍तु का पहला भाग****)**
 __
 
• ​E.g.__- I’ve read the article from **beginning** to end.
